-Elements (11/15): Most key elements are present, including the navigation, post composer, sidebars, feed controls, comments, and recommended Bowls. The first feed item is missing its “Discover new communities” label and “Join Bowl” control, and some icons and avatars differ.
-Content and Text (31/40): Much of the visible post text, comment text, sidebar list, and labels match. However, some feed details are omitted, including the first post’s community prompt, and the lower post image appears much earlier and more fully than in the reference.
-Style (12/15): The white background, green branding, typography, borders, and muted card styling are broadly consistent. Some icon treatments and text sizing differ, and the compressed feed spacing changes the overall appearance.
-Overall (15/20): The page is a recognizable recreation with a strong match in structure and much of its content. Missing feed details and the substantial vertical-position difference near the lower post keep it from being closer.

-Layout (9/10 points): The centered modal, dimmed backdrop, and three-column page layout closely match. The generated modal is slightly narrower and shorter, and the background columns are positioned a little differently.
-Elements (13/15 points): Nearly all key components are present, including the post, engagement controls, comment box, comment sorting, replies, and side panels. The reference has a visible scrollbar in the modal and some small icon and spacing differences.
-Content and Text (38/40 points): The post and visible comments are reproduced with very high fidelity, along with most surrounding labels and bowl listings. A few line wraps and minor details differ.
-Style (13/15 points): Typography, colors, borders, and the subdued overlay are very similar. The generated version has slightly different spacing and comment-card treatment.
-Overall (18/20 points): A strong match to the reference, with the modal and its content especially close. Remaining differences are mostly small sizing, alignment, and scroll-state details.

-Elements (15 points): Header, bowl sidebar, feed cards, and recommendation panel are recognizable. The modal introduces a post detail view, comment composer, sorting control, and expanded comments that do not appear in the reference. (9/15)
-Content and Text (40 points): The Worklife Bowl post and its first comment match the reference, as do many surrounding bowl names and navigation labels. However, the reference shows multiple feed posts in the central column, while the generated view focuses on one expanded post and includes different comment text. (23/40)
-Style (15 points): The typography, green accents, white cards, and general Glassdoor styling are close. The dimmed backdrop and prominent modal substantially change the page’s appearance. (10/15)
-Overall (20 points): The generated page appears to depict the same site and content, but in a post-detail/comment modal state rather than the reference’s unobstructed feed state. (10/20)
